references.text: David encourages praising God, who is in heaven, and this reflects the opening of the prayer that God's name be kept holy.
Shows reverence for God by keeping His name holy.
Micah expresses a desire for God's name to be honored, parallel to the prayer's focus on the holiness of God's name.
The entire prayer that Jesus taught his disciples, including prayers for God's kingdom and will.
Luke's version of the Lord's Prayer, which also begins with hallowing God's name.
